services.desc: My two boys joined last summer for a trial week. To my surprise, they fell in love, and they decided to join and commit to the sport. The instructors are very engaged with their growth and development. Whether they communicate to them in person or via postcard mailing, they make my boys feel appreciated for their effort and are crucial members of their school. If you are thinking about it, give them a try, you won't be disappointed. I Always wished for my son to learn Takenwando but he was super scared to join any facility thinking he might hurt someone.
